description:
The archival plan's warning vocabulary gains a stable code for an in-content citation of a moving artifact's path, extending a closed schema contract deliberately.

## Background

Plan warnings are a closed vocabulary: a fixed enumeration, a fixed-length exhaustive array, stable wire spellings, and a golden assertion that compares the array against those spellings. Adding a code touches all four and is an explicit schema decision rather than a free addition. The warning channel itself already exists at both target level and per-artifact level and is already present in the machine-readable envelope, so no new channel is needed.

This issue adds the vocabulary entry and its contract coverage only. Producing the warning from a content scan is separate work.

The adopter command reference is not edited here. This epic's command-surface changes are documented together in that one reference, so this issue's footprint names only the files it mutates.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The warning vocabulary carries a new code for an in-content path citation of a moving artifact.
- [hard] REQ-02: The exhaustive warning array and its length include the new code.
- [hard] REQ-03: The new code has a stable kebab-case wire spelling.
- [hard] REQ-04: The golden contract assertion covers the new code and continues to derive both comparison sides from the enumeration.
title: Add a plan-warning code for in-content path citations
